description: Four ring-modulator channels: each multiplies its input by a gain set by a knob and modulated by a CV input, with chained outputs

params.text: Sets the gain of that channel from -1 to 1, the centre muting it and counter-clockwise inverting it
Attenuverts that channel's CV input, which adds to the gain knob and can push the gain as far as -2 or 2

inputs.text: The signal for that channel; with nothing patched it reads a constant 5V, so the knob puts out an adjustable offset instead
Modulates that channel's gain through its attenuverter, 5V at full attenuverter changing the gain by one; with audio here and audio on the signal input the channel is a ring modulator

outputs.text: That channel, summed with any channel above it whose own output is unpatched

notes: the module is monophonic: on a polyphonic cable only the first channel is read.
